title: ToolApiV1
description: K-09 Tool API v1, frozen by T-018 (T-009 drafted the turn face and the shared core; T-018 added the setup calls journeys 1 and 2 use, the exchanges and the fixtures). The calls that own every read and write (arch 02 line 139; arch 12 line 590: generated from the master's needs and gives keys): the turn face (called by the handle actor and the AI layer), the shared core (M3b: the any-time rows every chat needs from its first text) and the setup calls of journeys 1 and 2 (S1-01 to S1-84, S2-02 to S2-31). The same calls serve texts, secure pages and outside AIs under the same limits; free text from pages and AIs gets the safety read first (arch 02 line 129); row-level security per business on every call (arch 10 line 546). Each call's request, response and errors are definitions under $defs named <call>.request, <call>.response and <call>.errors (02-contracts section 2 item 2), and <call>.exchange pairs one request with its outcome, which is what every fixture is and what the Tool API mock answers from (C-186). The root is any one exchange, so the type generator writes a type for every call (ADR-005). contracts/tool-api/README.md states each call's read, repeat safety and time budget.

The same calls serve texts, secure pages and outside AIs under the same limits (arch 02 line 129).

buildFrontier.request.title: BuildFrontierRequest
buildFrontier.request.description: Build the frontier: the turn, its targets from the guard and the pinned bundle give K-02 v1's context (choices, cards, facts with their row versions, the rules prefix by hash, the last 6 messages). Each fact comes once from its one home (S13-30); a second value for one key is refused, the home's value goes in and the step is flagged for a fix (arch 02 line 117; arch 03 lines 157 to 167). Over 60 choices, each booking other than the target collapses to one 'which booking?' choice (arch 03 line 167). Reads: the primary, uncached (decision reads: arch 02 line 117; arch 10 lines 504, 538), and the pinned bundle from KV (its PostgreSQL copy on a miss: arch 10 line 536). Repeat: safe: a read; it writes nothing (a flagged step is reported in the response and on the frontier span). Time budget: at most 150 ms (arch 04 line 215: 'Build the frontier (uncached reads)').

The model or index is Q-42's (a spike picks it). Reads: the pinned bundle and the meaning-match index (Q-42); the facts an added entry needs are read as buildFrontier reads them, on the primary, uncached. Repeat: safe: a read; the same context gives the same entries. Once per turn: a second call for one turn is refused (searchedAlready). Time budget: none in the sources. Proposed: at most 200 ms, the budget of 'Search, one indexed query' (arch 04 line 217, DD), since it is one indexed query (README default 3).

gateAndCommit.request.title: GateAndCommitRequest
gateAndCommit.request.description: Gate and commit a turn: the gate checks limits 1 to 6 on the agreed parts with their quotes; code adds each choice's effects; one transaction writes state, one outbox row per message (no plan yet), clock rows, effect rows and the event log under the turn id (arch 02 line 121; arch 06 lines 295 to 309; arch 10 line 508). It commits through K-05 v1 commitTurn, or for a clock's firing through K-05 v1 fireClock (QUESTIONS.md NQ-RT-4); effect rows and the waiting rows' moves (K-07 v1 waiting_chat to superseded or withdrawn) are K-05 v1.1's (T-071). A limit 4 or 5 refusal from the commit reloads once and gates again (arch 06 line 305). Reads: the primary, uncached (arch 02 line 117; arch 10 lines 504, 508). Repeat: safe: the turn id is the key; a repeat writes nothing and returns the first commit with repeated true (K-05 v1 commitTurn; tour line 418). Time budget: at most 300 ms (arch 04 line 223: 'Gate and commit').

composeInput.request.title: ComposeInputRequest

An email copy takes its text row's plan instead, so it gets no composer input (arch 07 line 397). After a crash only rows without a plan are composed (arch 11 line 576). Reads: the primary, uncached: the row and today's record (limit 7 reads what this recipient may see: arch 06 line 311). Repeat: safe: a read. Time budget: none in the sources; it sits inside 'Write the reply, or one rewrite: 2–3 s' (arch 04 line 225).

finalizeMessage.request.title: FinalizeMessageRequest
finalizeMessage.request.description: Finalize a message: for an outbox row and its plan, code inserts the options word for word, adds the fixed lines, fills the slots, runs the claim check (limit 7) and the message checks (arch 02 line 123; arch 07 lines 405 to 417). Every check passed, or only shape, length and reading after the one rewrite: the final parts are written with the plan (K-05 v1 writePlan; K-07 v1 planned to checked). A blocking miss on the composed plan: the failed checks come back for the one rewrite. A blocking miss on the rewrite: code fills the step's fallback text (Jay's reviewed one, or its master line with slots filled) through the same checks; none passes: 'I've passed this on. Rosie's team will reply within 1 business day.', the question withdrawn so no clock arms (K-05 v1 cancelClock with withdrawQuestion; RULES 5.2), and the team paged (pageTeam, reason passed_on). Reads: the primary, uncached: the row, its slots' values and the reader's audience (limit 7: arch 06 line 311). Repeat: safe: a row with a plan keeps it; a repeat answers alreadyPlanned with the stored final parts (K-05 v1 writePlan). Time budget: none in the sources; the checks are code, inside 'Write the reply, or one rewrite: 2–3 s' (arch 04 line 225).

matchKinds.request.title: MatchKindsRequest
matchKinds.request.description: Match the owner's words to kinds of work (S1-02; arch 05 line 237: 'an owner's words at sign-up are matched by meaning to the closest of the 243 kinds, and the owner picks'): each part of the words gets the closest kinds of K-24 v1 kinds, for the owner to pick; words that fit two get one 'which?'; none fits: new work (S1-03), or a service Rosie never books (S1-74; RULES 1.4). The model or index is Q-42's (a spike picks it). Called by the frontier builder for S1-02's facts, and by registration screen 1 through K-21. Reads: the primary, uncached, and the meaning-match index (Q-42). Repeat: safe: a read. Time budget: none in the sources; proposed at most 200 ms, as closestEntries (README default 3).

words.description: The owner's words as typed (S1-02: 'Just type them').

flow.description: The flow the kinds are read for (K-24 v1 kind_flows.flow).

kinds.description: The closest kinds, closest first: one for listed, two for which, none otherwise.

Banned words in a listing are never shown (S13-11). Called by the frontier builder for S1-09's facts and by registration screen 2 through K-21. Reads: the Places port and the business's own setup row on the primary, uncached. Repeat: safe: a read. Time budget: none in the sources; the port's own.

lookupListing.response.title: LookupListingResponse

listingRef.description: The Places port's reference (K-15, not frozen: opaque).

alreadyOnRosie.description: true when a business already holds this listing: S1-76's review (S1-09 'No match, or already listed').

oneOf.title: PlacesUnavailableError

saveSetupStep.request.title: SaveSetupStepRequest
saveSetupStep.request.description: Save one setup step of journeys 1 and 2 and write the keys it gives (arch 12 line 590: the Tool API generated from the master's needs and gives keys; 02-contracts K-09 'Journey 1', 'Journey 2'; README 'Journeys 1 and 2'). In a turn, a step's write is the effect code adds for the choice decide picked, inside gateAndCommit's one commit, and the part's result names the keys it gave (partResult.gives); from a page (registration screens, the staff page, the pay page: K-21) or the console it is called alone and commits under caller.requestId, which waits for K-05's commit with no turn (CQ-44). The step must be one the record has reached with its needs given (needsMissing otherwise). Reads: the primary, uncached. Repeat: safe: the turn or request id is the key; a repeat writes nothing and answers repeated. Time budget: in a turn, inside gateAndCommit's 300 ms (arch 04 line 223); alone, none in the sources.

step.description: The step and what it saves, one variant per step (A-S1.md, A-S2.md; B-S1.md and B-S2.md hold the same steps).
